name: Coding Agent
description: Mock A2A coding agent for v2 repository-assistance demos. It never runs commands or modifies files.

skills.name: Repository Inspection
skills.description: Return deterministic read-only repository observations and a recommended next task.
examples: Review the current repo and suggest what coding task should be done next.

skills.name: Bug Fix Plan
skills.description: Prepare a deterministic bug-fix plan that requires confirmation before any repository modification.
examples: Fix the failing test in this repo.

skills.name: PR Review
skills.description: Return deterministic read-only review feedback for repository changes.

skills.name: Test Generation Plan
skills.description: Prepare deterministic test-generation advice; writing tests requires confirmation.

skills.name: Documentation Draft
skills.description: Generate deterministic documentation advice or draft content without modifying files.
